fusions.name: Poultice
fusions.desc: Fires a spore that draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 16 poison damage, 60% more for each one drawn. 20% of the damage comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured Dose
fusions.desc: Releases a puff of spores that deals 4 poison damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and restores 1 health to you.

fusions.name: Bitter Filter
fusions.desc: Draws up to 3 conditions out of you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Spent Toxin
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You carry 8% poison resistance.
